metadata.title: Check Point Exposure Management - Inbound Status Sync (Argos → Microsoft Sentinel)
metadata.description: Runs on a schedule and mirrors Argos alert status changes onto the Microsoft Sentinel incidents created for them. It reads the latest Argos state from the argsentdc_CL table, finds the incident through the ref_id Custom Detail, and updates the incident status and classification when Argos changed more recently than the incident. Newest change wins.
prerequisites: 1. The Check Point Cyberint Alerts data connector must be connected and ingesting into argsentdc_CL.
2. Incidents must be created by the Check Point Exposure Management - Argos alerts to incidents analytic rule, which provides the ref_id Custom Detail.
3. The Microsoft Sentinel workspace must be in the resource group given by Workspace_Resource_Group.
postDeployment: 1. Grant the Logic App Managed Identity the **Microsoft Sentinel Responder** role on the workspace resource group. It covers both the log query and the incident updates.

releaseNotes.title: Check Point Exposure Management - Inbound Status Sync

metadata.description: Name of the Logic App / Playbook
Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled
Resource group of the Microsoft Sentinel workspace (default: the playbook's resource group)
How often to check for Argos status changes, in minutes

body.query:
let ChangedWindow = @{mul(max(parameters('PollingIntervalMinutes'), 10), 3)}m;
let Lookback = 90d;
let Changed = argsentdc_CL
    | where ingestion_time() > ago(ChangedWindow)
    | distinct ref_id = tostring(ref_id);
let ArgosHistory = argsentdc_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | extend ref_id = tostring(ref_id), ArgosStatus = tostring(status)
    | where ref_id in (Changed)
    | project ref_id, TimeGenerated, ArgosStatus,
              ClosureReason = tostring(closure_reason),
              ClosureDescription = tostring(closure_reason_description);
let ArgosState = ArgosHistory
    | sort by ref_id asc, TimeGenerated asc
    | extend IsTransition = ref_id != prev(ref_id) or ArgosStatus != prev(ArgosStatus)
    | where IsTransition
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ArgosStatus) by ref_id
    | project ref_id, ArgosStatus, ArgosChangedAt = TimeGenerated
    | join kind=inner (ArgosHistory | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ClosureReason, ClosureDescription) by ref_id) on ref_id
    | project ref_id, ArgosStatus, ArgosChangedAt, ClosureReason, ClosureDescription;
let AlertRefs = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ProviderName == "ASI Scheduled Alerts"
    | extend ref_id = tostring(parse_json(tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties)["Custom Details"])).ref_id[0])
    | where ref_id in (Changed)
    | distinct SystemAlertId, ref_id;
let IncidentRefs = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | mv-expand AlertId = AlertIds to typeof(string)
    | join kind=inner AlertRefs on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
    | distinct IncidentName, ref_id;
let SentinelState = SecurityIncident
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where IncidentName in ((IncidentRefs | project IncidentName))
    | sort by IncidentName asc, LastModifiedTime asc
    | extend IsCreation = IncidentName != prev(IncidentName)
    | extend IsTransition = IsCreation or Status != prev(Status)
    | where IsTransition
    | summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, Status, IsCreation) by IncidentName
    | project IncidentName, SentinelStatus = Status,
              SentinelChangedAt = iff(IsCreation, datetime(null), LastModifiedTime);
ArgosState
| join kind=inner IncidentRefs on ref_id
| join kind=inner SentinelState on IncidentName
| extend TargetStatus = case(ArgosStatus == "open", "New", ArgosStatus == "acknowledged", "Active", ArgosStatus == "closed", "Closed", "")
| where isnotempty(TargetStatus) and TargetStatus != SentinelStatus
| where isnull(SentinelChangedAt) or ArgosChangedAt > SentinelChangedAt
| extend Classification = case(
    TargetStatus != "Closed", "",
    ClosureReason == "resolved", "TruePositive",
    ClosureReason in ("false_positive", "irrelevant_alert_subtype"), "FalsePositive",
    ClosureReason in ("no_longer_a_threat", "irrelevant", "asset_should_not_be_monitored",
                      "asset_belongs_to_my_organization", "asm_no_longer_detected", "asm_manually_closed"), "BenignPositive",
    "Undetermined")
| extend ClassificationReason = case(
    Classification == "TruePositive", "SuspiciousActivity",
    Classification == "BenignPositive", "SuspiciousButExpected",
    ClosureReason == "false_positive", "IncorrectAlertLogic",
    ClosureReason == "irrelevant_alert_subtype", "InaccurateData",
    "")
| extend ClassificationComment = iff(TargetStatus != "Closed", "",
    substring(iff(isnotempty(ClosureDescription),
        ClosureDescription,
        strcat("Closed in Check Point Exposure Management (closure reason: ", coalesce(ClosureReason, "none"), ")")), 0, 1000))
| project IncidentName, RefId = ref_id, ArgosStatus, ClosureReason, TargetStatus,
          Classification, ClassificationReason, ClassificationComment,
          ArgosChangedAt, SentinelStatus, SentinelChangedAt

properties.message:
CPEM Inbound Status Sync:
Argos alert @{items('For_each_incident')['RefId']} changed to @{items('For_each_incident')['ArgosStatus']}@{if(empty(items('For_each_incident')['ClosureReason']), '', concat(' (closure reason: ', items('For_each_incident')['ClosureReason'], ')'))}.
Microsoft Sentinel status changed from @{body('Get_incident')?['properties']?['status']} to @{items('For_each_incident')['TargetStatus']}@{if(empty(items('For_each_incident')['Classification']), '', concat(', classification ', items('For_each_incident')['Classification'], if(empty(items('For_each_incident')['ClassificationReason']), '', concat(' / ', items('For_each_incident')['ClassificationReason']))))}.
